audit: 55/55 official names · 1P 2G 6S 46B · 28 PSN-hidden · 55/55 guides cited · sources read 21 Nov 2026 · 1 possibly missable
list: the official 55 trophies, published 18 Nov 2026 (Exophase + PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade)
note: Hidden flags: PSN hides 28 trophies until earned. The starter list carries no hidden flags, so this entry assigns hidden status from the guides' facts — story and mission trophies plus spoiler-heavy ones — and says so honestly on the Sources tab.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the story, the stranger strands, the collectibles and the activities, and this unlocks last. Budget roughly 200 hours, with the 100% completion checklist (A Long Road) as the longest grind. Sources: PowerPyx and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, which introduces Jason and Lucia and the Leonida setting. It is the first story mission of the game, so it unlocks naturally within the first hour of play and cannot be missed. Just follow the on-screen objectives until the mission ends. Sources: PowerPyx and PlanetGTA6.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through every mission of Chapter 1 until the chapter closes. Chapter trophies unlock automatically when the final mission of the chapter is done, so there is no special requirement beyond finishing the story. Do the Chapter 1 meditation step for Positive Mental Attitude before the chapter ends, while you are here. Sources: PowerPyx and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish all of Chapter 2's missions and the trophy unlocks when the chapter ends. Like every chapter trophy it is unmissable — free-roam continues after the story and the story itself is linear, so you cannot lock yourself out of it. Keep pushing the main missions forward. Sources: PowerPyx and PlanetGTA6.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 in full and the trophy pops at the chapter's close. There is no side requirement: chapter trophies are awarded for story progress alone. If you are tracking collectibles as you go, Vice City is a good time to bank a few, but nothing here is missable. Sources: PowerPyx and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the last mission of Chapter 4 and the chapter trophy unlocks. By this point the endgame is close, so use the lull before the finale to sweep up stranger strands and collectibles you have been passing. The trophy itself needs nothing but story progress. Sources: PowerPyx and PlanetGTA6.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission in Chapter 5 and this gold trophy unlocks. It is the story's natural endpoint, so it cannot be missed, and free-roam continues afterwards for everything still left to clean up. Do not worry about 100% before the finale — the checklist only becomes viewable after the story anyway. Sources: PowerPyx and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies unlock simply by finishing the named mission, and the story is linear, so this one is unmissable. Play the mission through to its end screen. Sources: PowerPyx and GamesFuze.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story beats, so the trophy is awarded for finishing the mission — no optional objective or rating is needed, and there are no mission gold medals in this game. Follow the plan, finish the job, and move on. Sources: PowerPyx and GamesFuze.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like every mission trophy, it unlocks on completion alone — there is no extra condition hidden in the description. Keep playing the main story and it will come. Sources: PowerPyx and PlanetGTA6.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Mission trophies are pure story progress: finish the mission and the trophy pops. No replay or medal system exists, so a sloppy run still counts as long as you reach the end. Sources: PowerPyx and GamesFuze.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Finish the mission and the trophy is yours; it cannot be missed. If you later want Catch Me If You Can, the airport is the same area to revisit in free-roam. Sources: PowerPyx and PlanetGTA6.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. As with the other mission trophies, completion alone is enough — the game has no mission replay and no gold medals, so one successful run is all it takes. Sources: PowerPyx and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which only becomes viewable after the story ends — but everything you did during the story already counts toward it. PowerPyx notes the checklist is roughly 60% of 'true' completion, with lenient thresholds, so it is long rather than brutally hard. Save this for last: finish the story, open the checklist, and mop up whatever categories are short. Sources: PowerPyx and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 unique stunts across Leonida — jumps, near-misses, airtime and other driving feats, tracked as distinct stunts rather than repeats of the same trick. Work on it passively while travelling: take jumps, thread traffic and use ramps whenever you see them instead of fast-travelling everywhere. The counter builds up over the whole playthrough, so start early and it will finish itself. Sources: PowerPyx and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once — races, fishing, arcade games, shooting range, drone races, bowling, hunting, challenges and the other open-world pastimes the game offers. You only need to sample each one, not win or master it, so a single quick attempt per activity is enough. Tick them off early in free-roam so you know where each activity lives. Sources: PowerPyx and PlanetGTA6.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is a pure skill grind: visit the range, learn each challenge's target pattern and time limit, and repeat until gold. Pick weapons you are accurate with, and take the challenges one weapon class at a time rather than jumping between them. Sources: PowerPyx and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Each location hosts its own race, so you need a win at every one of them, not 14 wins at the same spot. Learn the racing line for each course, cut through the gates cleanly, and retry a location until the win lands. Sources: PowerPyx and PlanetGTA6.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the key word is different, so each race course counts once and repeats of the same race do not add to the total. Work through the race list across Leonida, picking a fast car suited to each course, and keep a note of which ones you have already won. Pair it with the drone races and other driving activities while you are out. Sources: PowerPyx and GamesFuze.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: land the better catch within the challenge's rules, keeping tension on the line without snapping it. Take your time reeling, watch the line, and retry the challenge if Cal outfishes you — it can be attempted again. Sources: PowerPyx and GTAScoop.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish a full game at any arcade machine in Leonida, not just start one. Pick a machine whose game you enjoy, learn its controls, and play it through to the end screen. Any single completion counts, so choose the easiest cabinet you find. Sources: PowerPyx and PlanetGTA6.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's stranger strand through to its final mission, 'Puff Puff Pass', and finish that mission. Stranger strands unlock as you progress the story — watch for Andy's icon, play each of his missions in order, and return when new ones appear. PowerPyx notes all trophy-related quest givers return in free-roam, so you cannot lock this out by progressing the story. Sources: PowerPyx and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play through Kenton's stranger strand to its final mission and complete it. Kenton's missions appear as you move through the story — follow his icon whenever it shows up and finish each step before the next unlocks. Like the other stranger finals, it stays available in free-roam, so there is no window to miss. Sources: PowerPyx and PlanetGTA6.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's stranger strand, finishing his final mission, The Lone Rider. Billy's missions unlock with story progress, so keep an eye out for his icon between story missions and clear each one as it appears. The strand's givers return in free-roam, so you can finish it after the story too. Sources: PowerPyx and GamesFuze.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying stranger mission strands across Leonida. The named stranger finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count toward this, so finish those five first and then pick up three more stranger strands you find in the world. Check the map for stranger icons regularly — new strands open up as the story advances. Sources: PowerPyx and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand by completing his final mission, Supply & Demand. Randy's missions appear as story progress unlocks them, so answer his icon whenever it appears and work the strand in order. It remains completable in free-roam after the story. Sources: PowerPyx and PlanetGTA6.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's stranger strand through to its final mission, Spin On This! Tyrone's missions unlock with story progress; follow his icon and finish each mission in sequence. As with the other stranger strands, the giver returns in free-roam, so this is not missable. Sources: PowerPyx and GamesFuze.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. This is the ONLY possibly missable trophy, so do it first. In Chapter 1, right after the main mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning: she says she will meditate and heads to the balcony — follow her and choose 'Accept'. That adds +1 to the Progress Menu counter, but it is NOT marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest. Sources disagree on whether that Chapter 1 session is required for the trophy: PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy, so our call is DO IT in Chapter 1 — it costs a minute and protects the platinum. Then meditate at every marked spot in the world. Sources: PowerPyx and TechWiser.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.sourcesDisagree: Chapter 1 meditation: counts +1 in the Progress Menu but is not marked as a Meditation Spot. Unconfirmed whether it is required. Safe call: do it in Chapter 1.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand points you at a specific rare animal — follow his lead, track it in the wild, and take the shot cleanly. Hunting is one of the nine activity types, so this also feeds Master of None. Bring a scoped weapon and approach quietly. Sources: PowerPyx and GTAScoop.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so collect them as you explore and check which sets are near-complete. Focus on finishing three sets rather than grabbing random singles — a set only counts once every card in it is found. Use the map and your collection screen to track what is missing. Sources: PowerPyx and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. This is a long passive collectible: whenever you are somewhere new, open WAiNK It and log the spot before moving on. It pairs naturally with The Goodtime State's full exploration of Leonida — sweep region by region and you will hit 100 without a dedicated grind. Sources: PowerPyx and PlanetGTA6.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more, and many complete themselves through normal play — stunts, races, robberies and collectibles all feed the counter. Check the challenge list, pick off the easy ones first, and let the rest accumulate as you chase the other trophies. Sources: PowerPyx and GamesFuze.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it in a fast car with a clear escape route planned: break line of sight, get out of the search area, and stay hidden until the stars clear. Doing it with your partner present is the requirement — solo escapes do not count. Sources: PowerPyx and GTAScoop.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level — meaning you must keep the heat on between robberies, not escape it. Plan a route with three shops close together, hit them quickly in sequence, and keep moving so the cops stay behind you. If the wanted level drops, the chain breaks and you start over. Sources: PowerPyx and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Every new vehicle you drive or spot adds to the count, so variety is the strategy: try different cars, bikes, boats and aircraft wherever you find them instead of sticking to one favourite ride. Exploration and the Scooter Bros registrations feed this naturally. Sources: PowerPyx and PlanetGTA6.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Find a spot with a cluster of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and chain your shots quickly before the effect ends. A busy shootout or a gang hideout gives you the targets you need — thin out stragglers first so five are in range when you activate it. Sources: PowerPyx and GamesFuze.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — in plain terms, steal a plane and take off without going through the normal channels. Head to the airport, grab an aircraft on the tarmac or runway, and get airborne. Expect police attention, so be quick and commit once you are rolling. Sources: PowerPyx and GTAScoop.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: This one is tied to the Rhino tanks — get involved with them, whether that means commandeering one or surviving an encounter with them. The description is deliberately cryptic, so expect a tank-related set piece or free-roam military encounter to trigger it. Keep an eye on military areas and wanted-level escalation involving armor. Sources: PowerPyx and EGamers.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: move slowly, stay out of sight lines, and take the loot without tripping alarms or alerting staff. A stealthy approach with a silenced weapon helps, and if you are spotted the attempt fails — leave, reset, and try again. Sources: PowerPyx and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vault robberies are bigger jobs than shop robberies: plan the approach, crack the vault, grab the cash and get clear before the response closes in. You need five successful escapes, so a fast getaway car and a route away from the bank matter as much as the robbery itself. Sources: PowerPyx and PlanetGTA6.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the roads — intercept one, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level. A heavy vehicle or a well-placed block works to stop the truck; after the grab, break line of sight fast. Sources: PowerPyx and GamesFuze.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — visit every area of the map, all 52 areas per the guides. Drive, fly and walk into each region until the map is filled in; the trophy pops when the last unexplored area is revealed. Pair it with WAiNK It spots and card hunting so each trip earns progress on several trophies at once. Sources: PowerPyx and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs its own operations around Leonida — find one per gang, hit it, and move to the next. Keep a checklist of which gangs you have done so you do not repeat one while missing another. Sources: PowerPyx and PlanetGTA6.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The official description is all the guides have to go on — the exact bar, drink or trigger is still being confirmed by players, and PowerPyx lists this among the methods not yet known. Our call: head to Ocean Beach, find a bar or venue with a view, and order a cocktail; if nothing triggers, check back as the community confirms the spot. Do not take any single unverified location as fact. Sources: PowerPyx and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.sourcesDisagree: Method unconfirmed — the exact bar or trigger on Ocean Beach is not yet verified. Listed as not yet known by PowerPyx.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description nods to the series' famous showroom escape, but which showroom and what exactly triggers it are still unconfirmed — PowerPyx lists this method as not yet known. Our call: visit a vehicle showroom, take a car, and drive it straight out through the glass; if it does not pop, wait for the community to pin down the exact showroom. Sources: PowerPyx and GTAScoop.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.sourcesDisagree: Method unconfirmed — the exact showroom and trigger are not yet verified. Listed as not yet known by PowerPyx.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and play through a game — follow through on your shots, as the description puts it. This is a simple activity trophy: find the alley, rent a lane, and finish the game. It also counts as one of the nine activity types for Master of None. Sources: PowerPyx and PlanetGTA6.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: This trophy is tied to Jason and Lucia's partnership reaching its peak — max out strength with both characters, the 'partnership with mass appeal' the description hints at. Train strength for each of them through gyms and physical activity until both are maxed. It is a slow burn, so work on it alongside the story rather than leaving it to the end. Sources: PowerPyx and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Make choices — the description is deliberately vague, and PSN tracks a count toward 500 for this one. It appears to reward cumulative decisions made across the game, so just keep playing and choosing: dialogue options, mission approaches and open-world decisions all likely feed it. There is no single moment to hit; it accumulates over a full playthrough. Sources: PowerPyx and GamesFuze.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm' suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something — but which activity, and what counts as the second try, is still unconfirmed, and PowerPyx lists this method as not yet known. Our call: do not chase it blindly. Play normally, retry anything you fail, and check the community's findings as they land; this guide will be updated when the trigger is verified. Sources: PowerPyx and CryptoGames.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.sourcesDisagree: Method unconfirmed — what the 'second time' refers to is not yet verified. Listed as not yet known by PowerPyx.

trophies.guide: Something strange happens — and that is genuinely all anyone knows so far. The Truth Is Out There is a hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method: the guides agree the trigger is not yet known, and no specific location or event has been verified. Our call: explore Leonida's odd corners and easter-egg spots, and wait for the community to confirm the trigger rather than trusting any single rumour. Sources: PowerPyx and The Games Wiki.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: The Games Wiki — Trophies and Achievements

trophies.sourcesDisagree: Method unconfirmed — no location or event has been verified. Listed as not yet known by PowerPyx.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl people over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. The method is still being confirmed: the guides agree on the shape of it (melee, from a vehicle, knocking targets down) but the exact conditions are not yet verified. Our call: try melee drive-bys on pedestrians from a slow-moving car and see if it pops; do not treat any single reported trick as confirmed until the guides agree. Sources: PowerPyx and GTAScoop.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.sourcesDisagree: Method still being confirmed — the exact conditions of the melee drive-by are not yet verified.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and other illicit income — pass them to your laundering contacts over time and the total builds up. It is cumulative, so small amounts count, and it pairs naturally with the bank vault and shop robberies you are already doing. Sources: PowerPyx and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. This is cumulative spending — clothes, weapons, food, car mods and anything else you buy all count. You will make a big dent just gearing up through the story; in the endgame, top it up with vehicle upgrades or weapon purchases. No single purchase needs to be huge. Sources: PowerPyx and PlanetGTA6.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are bought as properties — save up, visit each one for sale, and buy it. They also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good, so buy them as you explore new areas. The trophy pops when the eighth garage is yours. Sources: PowerPyx and GamesFuze.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, open the app, and register each one — ten different registrations earn the trophy. It overlaps with Whip It Good's vehicle discovery, so register every new vehicle you find instead of only driving it. Sources: PowerPyx and PlanetGTA6.
trophies.name: On the Spot
